# V1: this is based on run_CellBarcode.v3.Rmd.

This version uses plate+wellid UMI and constant + barcode patterns.

Detect and cluster barcodes for whole plate. Results go under ./k562/run1/

call bc_extract_df() with default maxLDist=0. This only detect barcodes with full match to pattern.

Modified and re-ran: 05-Oct-2026
Prepare package for usage

# 1. read samplesheet for sample tags and constants

## 1.1 read samplesheet

```{r}
csvfile <- sprintf('/Users/lany/mount_drives/HPC_Projects/0/0ddcec61-75f4-4347-b696-e96ec587183c/data/results/YL/PIP-3583/Analysis/Barcode_analysis/UMIs.v2/%s.unix.csv',plateid)
df.csv <- read.csv(csvfile, header = T, sep = ',')
df.csv <- df.csv[,-c(1)]
colnames(df.csv) <- c('wellid', 'sample_tag1', 'const1', 'sample_tag2', 'const2')

```

# 2. Run pipeline following similar steps to YL's homebrew pipelines. Check outputs at each step.

## 2.1 aerosal filter to remove reads cov<2

load single fastq file, remove aerosal contaminant with cov=1;

```{r}
if (plateid=='plate6' | plateid=='k562'){
  fq_files <- file.path(fastq_dir,'plate6fullLIBk562_merged.fastq.gz')
} else {
  fq_files <- file.path(fastq_dir,sprintf('%s_merged.fastq.gz', plateid))
}
barcode_df.raw = read_fastq_gz(fq_files)
```
raw read stats: include reads from both wells. 
```{r}
head(barcode_df.raw)
# 1,649,882 uniq reads, total 21,877,770
print(dim(barcode_df.raw))
# [1] 1649882      2
plate_stats[['raw_reads_uniq']] <- dim(barcode_df.raw)[1]
sum(barcode_df.raw$freq)
# [1] 21877770
plate_stats[['raw_reads']] <- sum(barcode_df.raw$freq)

# remove cov<2
sum(barcode_df.raw$freq<=1)
# [1] 1153419
# after filtering: 496,463 uniq reads, total 20724351 reads.
barcode_df <- barcode_df.raw[barcode_df.raw$freq>1,]
dim(barcode_df)
# [1] 496463      2
plate_stats[['raw_read_cov>1_uniq']] <- dim(barcode_df)[1]
sum(barcode_df$freq)
# 20,724,351
plate_stats[['raw_read_cov>1']] <- sum(barcode_df$freq)
rm(barcode_df.raw)
```

## 2.2 detect unique reads matching sample_tags, constants and bc pattern backbones.
We already knew one well (H7) has failed the illumina indexing. Rest of the works will be solely on H8.
```{r}
well_stats <- c()
# sample 1 has no match - as already known
csv_row <- 2
### 2.2.1 select a well to analysis
process_stats <- c()
wellid <- df.csv[csv_row,1]

# "CTTGAGTAG"
sample_tag1 <- df.csv[csv_row,2]
# "GGCCTCTTCCGCGTCTTC"
const1 <- toupper(df.csv[csv_row,3])
sample_tag2 <- df.csv[csv_row,4]
const2 <- df.csv[csv_row,5]
# CCTAATGGA
sample_tag2.rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(x=sample_tag2)))
# TCTGTTGTTTGCCCCTCCC
const2.rc = toupper(as.character(reverseComplement(DNAString(x=const2))))
# barcode only pattern
# pattern = "GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT"
pattern.read = paste(sample_tag1,const1,"(.*)GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT(.*)",const2.rc,sample_tag2.rc,sep = "")
pattern.read
# [1] "CTTGAGTAGGGCCTCTTCCGCGTCTTC(.*)GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT(.*)TCTGTTGTTTGCCCCTCCCCCTAATGGA"
process_stats[['wellid']] <- wellid

### 2.2.2: fwd reads
matched_reads.fwd <- bc_extract_df(barcode_df, pattern.read, maxLDist = 0)

process_stats[['fwd.match_reads']] <- sum(matched_reads.fwd$count)

process_stats[['fwd.match_reads_uniq']] <- dim(matched_reads.fwd)[1]


### 2.2.3 rev reads
rc <- as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(x=barcode_df$seq)))
barcode_df.rc = barcode_df
barcode_df.rc$seq= rc

matched_reads.rc <- bc_extract_df(barcode_df.rc, pattern.read, maxLDist = 0)
process_stats[['rc.match_reads']] <- sum(matched_reads.rc$count)

# dim(matched_reads.rc)
# [1] 913   2
process_stats[['rc.match_reads_uniq']] <- dim(matched_reads.rc)[1]

### 2.2.4. merge fwd + rc reads
matched_reads.merged <- merge(matched_reads.fwd, matched_reads.rc, by.x="barcode_seq", by.y="barcode_seq", all.x=T, all.y=T)
matched_reads.merged$count.x[is.na(matched_reads.merged$count.x)]=0
matched_reads.merged$count.y[is.na(matched_reads.merged$count.y)]=0
matched_reads.merged$count.fwdrc <- matched_reads.merged$count.x + matched_reads.merged$count.y
matched_reads.merged <- matched_reads.merged[order(matched_reads.merged$count.fwdrc, decreasing = T),]
process_stats[['fwdrc.match_reads']]=sum(matched_reads.merged$count.fwdrc)

# dim(matched_reads.merged)
# [1] 1215    4
process_stats[['fwdrc.match_reads_uniq']] = dim(matched_reads.merged)[1]
# matched_reads.merged[1,]
# barcode_seq
#                                                                                                                                                                                            <char>
# 1: CTTGAGTAGGGCCTCTTCCGCGTCTTCGCCTTCGCCCTCAGACGAGTCGGATCTCCCTTTGGGCCGCCTCCCCGCCTTTGCTAGTCTACGCTCAGTCAGTGAGTTCGTACTATGCTCTTCAGGTATGACTAAGAGCGGTCTGTGCCTTCTAGTTGCCAGCCATCTGTTGTTTGCCCCTCCCCCTAATGGA
#    count.x count.y count.fwdrc
#      <num>   <num>       <num>
# 1:    1576    1651        3227
```

## 2.3 extract exact matching barcodes from merged reads
```{r}
# We expect each read contains a valid barcode.

matched_reads.merged <- matched_reads.merged[,c('barcode_seq', "count.fwdrc")]
colnames(matched_reads.merged) <- c('seq','freq')
# input detected reads for barcode detection
pattern.bc = "GCTC([ACTG]{3})CAG([ACTG]{3})GTT([ACTG]{3})ACT([ACTG]{3})CTC([ACTG]{3})AGG([ACTG]{3})GAC([ACTG]{3})GAGCGGT"
df.bc_backbone <- bc_extract_df(matched_reads.merged, pattern.bc, maxLDist = 0)
  #                                           barcode_seq count
  #                                                <char> <num>
  # 1: GCTCTGGCAGTGCGTTAAGACTTTGCTCGTTAGGATGGACTTGGAGCGGT 21928
  # 2: GCTCCAGCAGCTAGTTTCGACTTCTCTCATAAGGTTAGACAATGAGCGGT 16935
process_stats[['match_bc.reads']] <- sum(df.bc_backbone$count)

# found 555 barcodes before clustering
# dim(df.bc_backbone)
# [1] 555   2
process_stats[['match_bc.bcs']] <- dim(df.bc_backbone)[1]
if (OUTPUT) {
  # output reads and counts as csv.
  if(!dir.exists(sprintf('%s/k562/run1/bc_extract/%s', analysis_root,plateid))){
    dir.create(sprintf('%s/k562/run1/bc_extract/%s', analysis_root,plateid), recursive = T)
  }
  
  # all barcode detected from k562 cell line
  write.csv(df.bc_backbone, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/bc_extract/%s.bc.csv', analysis_root, wellid),
            row.names = F)
}
```

## 3. matching k562 barcodes to whitelist bc (potential barcodes from plate1-5) with Ld<=1
load whitelist bc
```{r}
df.whitelist <- read.csv(file=sprintf('%s/run2/plate1-5.final_bc_potential.csv', analysis_root), 
         sep = ',', header = F)
colnames(df.whitelist) <- c('bc', 'wellid')
```
match k562 df.bc_backbone to whitelist, allowing ld=1
```{r}
# for each k562 bc, compute the distance to whitelist, merge if ld<=1
# row: whitelist, col: k562 barcodes.
df.ld <- data.frame(lapply(df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq, function(x){stringdist(df.whitelist$bc, x, method = 'lv')} ))
colnames(df.ld) <- df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq
if (OUTPUT) {
save(df.ld, df.whitelist, df.bc_backbone,file=sprintf('%s/K562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root))
}

load(file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/Ld.RData', analysis_root), verbose = T)
df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist <- data.frame(whitelist=df.whitelist$bc, 
                                        wellid=df.whitelist$wellid, 
                                        reads=0,k562_bc="")

for (row in 1:nrow(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist)){
  if(sum(df.ld[row,]<=1)>0){
    matched_bc.seq <- df.bc_backbone$barcode_seq[df.ld[row,]<=1]
    matched_bc.counts <- df.bc_backbone$count[df.ld[row,]<=1]
    matched_bc.Ld <- df.ld[row,][df.ld[row,]<=1]
    # remove matched_bc
    df.ld[row,df.ld[row,]<=1]=1000
    str1 <- ''
    for (i in 1:length(matched_bc.seq)){
      str1 <- sprintf('%s%s:%d:%d;',str1,matched_bc.seq[i],matched_bc.Ld[i],matched_bc.counts[i])
    }
    df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist[row,"reads"] <- sum(matched_bc.counts)
    df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist[row,"k562_bc"] <- str1
  }
}
write.csv(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist, 
            file=sprintf('%s/k562/run1/%s.match_whitelist.csv', analysis_root,wellid),
            row.names = F, quote = F)
```
How many whitelist bc without NGS reads matching? How many NGS reads do not match to whitelist?

```{r}
# How many whitelist bc without NGS reads matching?
sum(df.bc_mapped_to_whitelist$reads==0)
# [1] 21
# How many NGS reads do not match to whitelist?
load(file=sprintf('%s/k562/Ld.RData', analysis_root), verbose = T)
k562.not_wl_match_bc <- c()
for (col in 1:ncol(df.ld)){
  if (sum(df.ld[,col]<=1)==0){
    k562.not_wl_match_bc <- c(k562.not_wl_match_bc, col)
  }
  
}
```
